    """Remove javascript: protocol URLs from href, src, and other attributes."""
    # Match javascript: URLs in attributes (href, src, action, formaction, etc.)
    # This pattern finds attribute="javascript:..." or attribute='javascript:...'
    pattern = r'(\s+(?:href|src|action|formaction|data|xlink:href)\s*=\s*)(["\'])javascript:[^"\']*\2'
    html = re.sub(pattern, r'\1\2\2', html, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    
    # Also handle unquoted javascript: URLs (though less common in valid HTML)
    pattern = r'(\s+(?:href|src|action|formaction|data|xlink:href)\s*=\s*)javascript:[^\s>]*'
    html = re.sub(pattern, r'\1""', html, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
